summary: Brera Holdings PLC (d/b/a Solmate Infrastructure) filed a Form 6-K reporting the termination of Marco Santori as CEO and director on April 24, 2026, and the appointment of Ron Sade as CEO effective May 1, 2026. The board believes Sade's experience in technology investment and digital infrastructure positions the company for strategic execution. Sade had served on the board since September 2025. This abrupt CEO departure constitutes a forced management change event. The filing includes no deal terms, as it solely concerns executive succession. Watch for potential further board changes or strategic shifts under the new leadership.
